text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? This is the extent of 
my current ability.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh! Once you decide which race McQueen 
is running in next, let me know, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And what do you intend to do once you hear 
it?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Revenge, of course! Next time, I'm 
definitely going to win!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...It is utterly pointless.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Pointless...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times we try, the 
result will not change. I will be the one 
to win... without fail!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ugh...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Jeez! Listen to this!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
McQueen told me, "No matter how many times 
we run, you will always lose to me!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I'd get beaten over and 
over! I'm the Umamusume who's going to 
surpass the Prez one day, aren't I?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"If they don't feel like competing, I'll 
definitely make them want to!"
choice_data_list: What are you planning to do?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll win an amazing race and show them 
what I'm made of! I won't let anyone say 
competing is meaningless!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So with that, make sure our next target 
race is a really, reeeally big one, okay!

Though she lost to Mejiro McQueen, Tokai 
Teio's ability is undeniably high.

Depending on her future growth, we believe 
she could comfortably aim for victory on 
the biggest stages—
choice_data_list: Next, let's challenge the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Waah! That's a suuuper big race! That's 
the race the President won too, right!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do this! Starting 
tomorrow, right into training!

And so, with the Tenno Sho (Spring) behind 
us, we set our sights on the next big 
stage, but—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... whew~...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, what do you think, Trainer? I can 
run just fine, can't I!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Right~!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And yet McQueen had to go and say there's 
no way I can win... Hmph, grrr...!

Even after a full night, Tokai Teio's 
excitement doesn't seem to have cooled 
down.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah! The Prez is training over there! 
Prez!! Preeeez!!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Teio, huh. Training the very day after a 
race— you're certainly full of drive.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, after all, I'm setting my sights on 
the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: More importantly, listen to this, Prexy!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
McQueen went and told me, "No matter how 
many times you run against me, victory 
shall be mine~" Can you believe her?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ho... And what do you think about it?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No way I'm gonna lose! After all, I'm 
aiming to surpass the President herself, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I got results even during my Classic year, 
and everyone around me says I've got real 
talent.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You think so too, right, Prez? Like, what 
is McQueen even talking about?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...No, I agree with what McQueen said as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Against the you of today, no matter how 
many times we try, the outcome will not 
change."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
W-Why...?! Even though I haven't done it 
yet...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's obvious without even trying; the 
difference is that vast. Between the 
McQueen of the Tenno Sho, and you as you 
are now, that is.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Teio, think carefully once more. About 
what she has that you are lacking.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: No way...

Tokai Teio began running toward the Japan 
Cup.

However, the voyage set sail under 
turbulent skies.
